deployments_detail.use: AI Contact Center (AICC): intelligent customer-response service that transcribes voice consultations to text, summarizes calls and analyzes customer sentiment to raise consultation quality. Originally built with LG AI Research's EXAONE. [LG AI Research (EXAONE)]

Enterprise generative-AI upskilling and work-automation program (with Elice LXP): employees built GPT-based chatbots for information extraction/report generation, data-analysis automation, and Google Apps Script email/document automation; role-based tracks for marketing (SNS content/hashtags), data analysis and planning. Marketing job-role training reached ~110 employees. [Elice; OpenAI (GPT)]

AI-driven cosmetic active-ingredient discovery: LG H&H, with LG AI Research, uses the EXAONE Discovery materials-discovery model to analyze molecular structures, predict properties and design high-efficacy cosmetic ingredients (e.g., improved solubility/safety), collapsing multi-year research cycles. Applied first to premium brand The Whoo / Skin Longevity ingredients. [LG AI Research (EXAONE Discovery)]
deployments_detail.value: Research period cut from ~1 year 10 months to ~1 day (per Korean press headlines)

deployments_detail.use: Hyper Rejuvenating Eye Patch, a wearable beauty device using AI-driven personalized skin analysis: a multi-modal model analyzes facial images, segments the eye area into micro-zones and evaluates aging indicators (fine lines, wrinkles, dark circles) against a 60,000-person skin database to personalize periocular care. Won a CES 2026 Innovation Award. [none]
IMPRINTU mini tattoo/body-art printer uses generative AI to create body-art design options for users, generating a large catalog of AI designs users select from. [none]

Visual AI for 'true personalization' skin research: LG H&H analyzed ~16,000 subjects with visual AI to reveal how different facial regions age at different rates and to surface inherent and health-related aging biomarkers, feeding personalized skincare recommendations. [none]

Generative-AI skin diagnosis solution: customer photographs their face, AI detects/segments the skin region and classifies it into one of 16 skin types, then recommends products. Built on AWS (Amazon Rekognition for face/skin detection + Amazon Bedrock foundation models), demonstrated at AWS Summit Seoul 2025. [AWS (Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Rekognition)]

100% generative-AI TV/video advertisement for the laundry-detergent brand FiJi, recreating brand-model table-tennis player Shin Yubin entirely with generative AI (no live shoot) in a spot where she 'competes' against Moraxella odor bacteria. [none]

AI-assisted product/package design workflow using generative AI tools (Midjourney + Adobe Creative Suite); the fabric-deodorizer brand Framon design produced via this process won a 2024 Good Design Award. [Midjourney; Adobe]
